subject: Fix coredump when use hellodict example module (#1395)
reason: The change only edits src/modules/hellodict.c, an example module that is not compiled into valkey-server and is only reachable via an explicit MODULE LOAD of a separately built hellodict.so. The fuzzer's experiments cannot load modules (MODULE LOAD/LOADEX are refused in command sequences, and the only environment artifact available is the parent server binary, not a module shared object), so no scenario can reach the fixed keystep behaviour. The server-side key-extraction code the bug crashed is unchanged; only the example's key-spec arguments were corrected.
